Mary?

lines.text: can you guess what that sound is?
What are you doing?

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: The weather tonight is so lovely,

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: so I thought it'd be nice to remember the waves,

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: and I wanted you to remember them too.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: With that being said,

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: do you prefer a sunny beach

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: in the middle of the day,

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: or a nighttime beach

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: with a sky full of stars?
I prefer a sunny daytime beach.
I prefer the beach at night.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: I knew it.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Whenever I see the sunlight reflecting off the water's surface,

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: I feel all warm and fuzzy inside.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: It's the same feeling I get when I'm around you, Commander.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: I'm so glad you like this kind of scenery as well!

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Oh, really?

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: You too?

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: I've always associated with you more

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: with bright daytime and warm temperatures,

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: so I thought that's what you'd prefer,

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: but I guess I was mistaken.
What about you, Mary?

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Hmmm

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: If I had to choose, I like the sea better at night, but

lines.speaker: mary_s

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: was an unforgettable experience in itself.

lines.text: In the Ark,

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: remotely like the ocean.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: You never get to see a night sky full of stars, either.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: The starlight reflected off the ocean's surface,

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: shimmering and coalescing together as one.

lines.speaker: mary_s
